description:
The Eagle-eye lookout Trail is a short uphill hike (approx. 1 km) that leads to an old Forestry lookout. On clear days the lookout provides great views of the surrounding area.

This trail is non-motorized.
directions: This trail is located North of Kamloops. Access is off the Lac du Bois Forest Service Road. At McQueen lake, turn onto the Isobel Lake FSR. At approx. 4km, a well defined parking area is located just off the main road on the south side of Isobel Lake.
title: Eagle Eye Lookout
